instructions: MENU MUSIC: every song in the songs list below plays on the menus (every screen except live games), in a random order.
STEP 1: put the MP3 in the public/music folder. Use lowercase file names without spaces, like friday-lights.mp3.
STEP 2 (optional): put a square cover image (about 300 x 300, JPG, PNG or WebP) in public/music/covers, like friday-lights.jpg.
STEP 3: copy one of the examples below into the songs list and change file, title, artist and cover to match.
NO COVER: leave out the cover line and the Now Playing pop-up shows the song's initials instead.
INTRO SONG: add "intro": true to ONE song. It plays first on the title screen when the game loads (once per visit), then joins the random rotation.
FORMAT: each song sits in { }, songs are separated by commas, and the last song has no comma after it. Text goes in double quotes.
RIGHTS: everything here is published on the live site and in the public GitHub repository. Only add music you have the right to share.
Only the songs list is played: the instructions and examples are ignored by the game.
